senses.gloss:
सौरभेयी

SAURABHEYĪ . A celestial maid. For details see under vargā.

सौरभी

SAURABHĪ . A cow which was the daughter of surabhi. Having drunk too much of celestial honey (amṛta) which is the essence of the six tastes (ṣaḍrasas), brahmā had to vomit, on which occasion, the cow surabhi sprang up from his face. Her milk having accumulated in a low place the milk-sea was formed. The hermits known as the Phenapas live on the shore of the milk sea, the foam that settles on the shore being their food. Around them, there are four cows which protect the four directions. saurabhī is one of them. She supports the east. haṁsikā bears the south, subhadrā the west and dhenu the north. (M.B. Udyoga Parva, Chapter 102).

शौरि

ŚAURI . vasudeva, the son of śūrasena.
